rules: One combined 25-minute study/concept allowance inside the 120-minute engineering allocation.
Stop at cap, carry unfinished lessons forward, and reduce implementation scope; no added hours.
Ticket blocks preserve exact lesson titles and links. Course mappings are recommendations; partial fit is labeled.
No course purchase/enrollment is requested. React and additional in28Minutes courses have unconfirmed access.
No mandatory AWS lecture is assigned in Days 1–30.

courses.title: Master Spring Boot 3 & Spring Framework 6 with Java

days.verified_lessons_line: **Day 1 API bridge (existing 25/85/10-minute budget):** [in28Minutes Official, *Master Spring Boot 3 & Spring Framework 6 with Java*](https://www.udemy.com/course/spring-boot-and-spring-framework-tutorial-for-beginners/), section **“Creating a Java REST API with Spring Boot, Spring Framework and Hibernate.”** Watch essential **“Step 02 - Creating a Hello World REST API with Spring Boot” (6:21)** then **“Step 03 - Enhancing the Hello World REST API to return a Bean” (4:30)** (10:51 total). If request/API terms are unfamiliar, add **“Step 00 - Creating a REST API with Spring Boot - An Overview” (4:04)**. **“Step 01 - Initializing a REST API Project with Spring Boot” (7:26)** is optional setup reference because the test-runtime fixture handles setup. Catalog titles were verified; videos were not watched. In 25 minutes, study the course and [runnable worked guide](docs/reboot/day-01-api-bridge.md); carry unfinished viewing forward. Use 85 minutes for the loopback reference and the separate small practice endpoint, not quote-selection implementation until the API bridge is understood. Use 10 minutes for exact observed response and request→method→Java value→HTTP explanation. This guide does not complete the original Day 1 quote-selection contract. The repository is Java 21/Spring Boot 4.1.1; do not downgrade or copy old setup instructions.
days.scope_note: The runnable loopback API guide is instructor-owned; the separate marked learner practice endpoint exercises the taught request/method/value/response flow. Original quote-selection remains separate and incomplete until its own acceptance is met.
